blocks.html: The data to validate that a return can be created and completed.

types.name: input
types.description: The data to create a return.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order to return items from.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the customer that's creating the return

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the order item to return.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The quantity of the item to return.

children.name: internal_note
children.description: An internal note viewed only by admin users.

children.name: reason_id
children.description: The ID of the reason indicating why the item is being returned.

children.name: note
children.description: More details about the returned item.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs of data to store in the return item.

children.name: return_shipping
children.description: The shipping details of the returned items.

children.name: option_id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option to use for the return.

children.name: price
children.description:
The custom amount to create the return shipping with.
If not provided, the shipping option's amount is used.

children.name: receive_now
children.description: Whether to mark the return as received immediately.

children.name: refund_amount
children.description: The amount to refund the customer.

children.name: location_id
children.description:
The ID of the location to return the items to.
If not provided, the return shipping option's location
is used.
